note: GLightbox integrates the pure-JS GLightbox library. Global config object glightbox.settings (groups custom/advanced/plyr) is edited at /admin/config/media/glightbox (route glightbox.admin_settings). Two image field formatters: glightbox and glightbox_responsive. ?glightbox=no disables it (glightbox.activation_check). Depends on core image; needs the GLightbox/Plyr/DOM Purify JS libs in /libraries. hook_glightbox_settings_alter overrides JS options. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real glightbox.settings config (custom.width) and a namespaced image field (field_glb_img) using the glightbox formatter.

evals.prompt: Where do I configure the global GLightbox settings on a Drupal 11 site, and what config object stores them?
evals.expected_output: The settings form is at /admin/config/media/glightbox (route glightbox.admin_settings, permission 'administer site configuration'); it writes the glightbox.settings config object (groups: custom, advanced, plyr).

evals.prompt: Which field formatters does the GLightbox module provide to make images open in a lightbox, and what field type are they for?
evals.expected_output: It provides two image field formatters: 'glightbox' (opens the image in a GLightbox popup) and 'glightbox_responsive' (same, using a responsive image style). Both apply to image fields and are set on Manage display.

evals.prompt: Is there a quick way to load a GLightbox-enabled page without the lightbox behavior wiring up, for debugging? What external libraries does GLightbox require?
evals.expected_output: Append ?glightbox=no to the URL; the glightbox.activation_check service then returns inactive so the lightbox isn't attached. GLightbox requires the GLightbox JS library (plus DOM Purify, and Plyr for video) installed under /libraries, and core's Image module.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the GLightbox lightbox width has been changed from its default. Inspect the live GLightbox configuration and state the currently configured lightbox width.
evals.expected_output: The configured width is 77%: glightbox.settings custom.width is '77%' (default is 98%).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, one image field on the Article content type is displayed with the GLightbox formatter (opens in a lightbox popup). Inspect the live default view display for Article and give that field's machine name.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_glb_img: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component uses the 'glightbox' formatter.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, change the GLightbox settings so the lightbox opens at 75% width instead of the default. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: glightbox.settings custom.width is set to '75%' (e.g. via the settings form at /admin/config/media/glightbox, or drush cset glightbox.settings custom.width 75%).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an image field field_glb_img currently shown with the plain image formatter. Configure the default view display so this field's images open in a GLightbox lightbox popup. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_glb_img component uses the 'glightbox' (or 'glightbox_responsive') formatter.
